'''Diab 6''' was the sixth [[Moon/Legends|moon]] orbiting the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Diab]] within the [[Diab system/Legends|Diab system]] of the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. It was orbited by the secret [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] known as [[The Prism]]. Diab's electrical storms wreaked havoc with sensors and no transmissions were allowed in or out of the prison.
